description: Iteration 2: shorter discharge headways and shorter queues, much higher red-running/early-start probabilities, space seeking redistributed from right lane to sidewalk, longer box hold.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car sim 0.74 vs obs 0.35 s and M5/length 48 vs 16 m: tau at its lower bound 0.4, minGap 1.0, accel 3.5 and sigma 0.2 shorten the discharge headway so queues clear faster; decel 6 limits collisions with the short tau.
M9a/per_cycle sim 1.0-1.9 vs obs 0.57 and M9b/share_blocked sim 0.11-0.15 vs 0.065: share cut from 0.08 to 0.04 so fewer cars take the right-turn lane.

M1/moto sim 0.49 vs obs 0.30 s and M5/length: tau 0.4, minGap 0.5, accel 6, sigma 0.3 shorten headway; lcPushy lowered 0.5 to 0.3 and minGapLat raised to 0.5 to reduce lane collisions (excluded runs) while keeping compact lateral packing for M5/moto_density and M4.

M6/approach l,u moto sim 145-223 s vs 42-54 s and M5/length: slow riders were too many and too slow (0.12, speedFactor 0.7) and clog the shared left lane; share 0.08 and speedFactor 0.8 keep behaviour 10 with less queue growth.
M10a/per_cycle sim 0.0-0.1 vs obs 0.56: straight riders eligible for space seeking; share kept at 0.25 and pushiness reduced 0.6 to 0.4 to cut collisions under TraCI intervention.
M7a/n_waiting (2.4 vs 5.6), M7b and M6/junction/illegal_l: keep the jmTimegapMinor 0.8 / impatience 0.8 setting whose M7b clear lag (5.3-5.6 s) matched the observed 5.46 s.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto sim 0.011-0.017 vs obs 0.13 (p 0.15 gave ~0.017, i.e. ~10% effective): p 0.9 over the full 10 s window raises it toward 0.13; also lifts M2/first_delay (0.7-1.0 vs 2.8 s) and creates overshoot for M4/overshoot_share.
M2/early/car sim 0 vs obs 0.011: p 0.02 gave no events; p 0.12 (about 10% effective, as for motos) gives ~0.01.
M3/share/moto sim 0.007 vs obs 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 0.29 vs 3.9: p0 0.06 gave ~12% effective; p0 0.45 (Saval 0.5 for front-row motos) with small k 0.03 keeps variance/mean near 1.14.
M3/share/car sim 0 vs obs 0.0041: p0 0.004 gave no events; p0 0.03 gives ~0.004 with no swarm effect.

M10a sim 0.0-0.1 vs obs 0.56 and M9a sim 1.0-1.9 vs 0.57 (right lane drawn 3x more than sidewalk): p_right_lane 0.05 to 0.02, p_sidewalk 0.08 to 0.5; p_wrong_lane 0 because it is inapplicable (R27) and was redistributed into right lane; q 8 m and t_w 20 s trigger earlier (M10b/M9c queue at choice 35-55 vs 15 m).
M7a/release_time sim -1.3 to -5.3 vs obs +2.78 s (box exit too early, lag 1.0-1.5): lag 2.2 shifts exit later; kept below 3 so M7b clear lag stays near 5.5 s.
Behaviour 10 / M4/lat_moto (sim 7.25 vs 7.19 m close): slow riders keep the lane centre, unchanged.
